source_snapshot.procedure: Verify UART from BMC to USB-C functional.
source_snapshot.criteria: UART is functioning normally and can send and receive traffic.
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 20 attended/20 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; lists BMC tty devices with insecure/malformed truncated SSH and leaves traffic to an operator.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/MEDIUM; held Pending for BMC device-tree/USB-C/tty mapping, getty/console/debug ownership, independent recovery, peer, serial profile and traffic criteria.

old_problem: Listing tty nodes does not identify the BMC-to-USB-C route or prove two-way data. Opening the wrong BMC UART can inject commands into its console/debug channel or remove the only management path; settings, peer and criteria are absent.
disposition_reason: A safe parameterized case can require device-tree/topology binding and proof the selected endpoint is not the sole console before any write, then use an isolated operator-provided peer for bounded two-way byte-integrity testing while monitoring independent management. The exact BMC tty, service ownership and serial values are project configuration behind a closed gate.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2167, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2168 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00055-V002 / 39f1f83565ac7925 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Bind BMC UART controller/device-tree alias through connector/adapter to a stable endpoint; wildcard `/dev/ttyS*` or ttyUSB order is insufficient.
Capture console/getty/debug/service ownership and prove an independent management/recovery channel remains available before opening the line.
Operator attaches the approved isolated loopback/peer; bind exact serial profile and bounded non-sensitive frames for both directions.
PASS requires exact bytes/order/count, allowed timeout/error deltas and uninterrupted BMC management, followed by restoration of original endpoint ownership.
Do not stop getty, change bootargs/device tree, send control escapes, clear logs, reset BMC/UART/USB or automatically retry.
No BMC enumeration, service change, port open, physical connection, traffic, reset, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: BMC-UART-to-USB-C device-tree-bound bidirectional and management-safety validation
test_case.purpose: Prove the intended BMC UART is routed to USB-C and passes clean two-way traffic through the approved peer without affecting its console, debug services or management availability.
required_package: BMC controller/device-tree alias to USB-C/adapter/stable-endpoint map
Console/getty/debug/service ownership and independent recovery path
Signed serial profile, bounded payload/directions, timeout and error limits
Complete BMC/USB/UART logs, cleanup and recovery procedure
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Operator confirms the physical peer. Preserve endpoint ownership and full logs, prove independent management, open only the approved non-critical endpoint with the signed profile, exchange bounded framed payloads both directions, compare bytes/order/count/timeouts/errors and BMC health, then close and restore the original service state.
test_case.expected_result: The mapped BMC-to-USB-C path transfers the exact approved frames in both directions within limits, no serial/USB or console event occurs, independent BMC management stays healthy and endpoint ownership is restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires path/ownership/physical proof, complete two-way integrity evidence and uninterrupted management. FAIL on wrong endpoint, byte mismatch, one-way failure, serial/reset event, prompt/debug interaction or management degradation. Missing map/peer/profile is runtime BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until device-tree map, service ownership, independent recovery, serial contract and peer are signed.
No sole-console access, service stop, bootarg/device-tree change, control escapes, wildcard tty, unbounded traffic or secrets.
Stop on prompt/debug interaction, wrong peer, management degradation, reset/disconnect or UART errors; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization and BMC controller/device-tree/connector/endpoint map
Operator photo and independent management/recovery proof
Full console/getty/debug/service ownership plus USB/UART baseline
Exact profile and timestamped two-way framed payload with byte/error comparison
Continuous BMC health and restored original endpoint/service state
test_case.recovery: Stop immediately on console or management impact, preserve evidence and close the endpoint without further traffic. Restore only the signed service/ownership state through the independent recovery path; do not reset BMC/UART/USB or retry automatically.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require functional bidirectional BMC UART traffic through USB-C.

blocked.reason: The BMC-specific topology/ownership method and safety boundary are complete; exact endpoint, peer and profile are runtime project bindings.

pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED; PARAMETERIZED BMC UART GATE CLOSED; NO ENUMERATION, SERVICE CHANGE, PORT OPEN, PHYSICAL CONNECTION, TRAFFIC, RESET, RETRY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: BMC firmware/device-tree and platform owner, management-service owner and lab operator
pending.unlock_condition: Bind signed endpoint/ownership/peer/profile/limits and authorize operator setup plus bounded traffic; no new review decision is required absent BMC routing change.

external_authorities.application: Requires end-to-end evidence, manual physical setup, secure management access, signed criteria, recovery and no automatic retry.

project_authority: BMC owner binds controller/device-tree and service ownership; platform owner maps connector/adapter; operator supplies peer; engineer owns verdict.
